basketRule: Fixed chase basket: English raw singles, Diamond & Pearl through Sun & Moon (DP / Platinum / HGSS / BW / XY / SM). Exclude Wizards vintage, EX-era, Sword & Shield, and Scarlet & Violet. Price-weighted S&P-style. Not a weekly rebalance (unlike a Double Holo Mid-Era 100).

selection.method: Take the committed EN Top 500 (liquid TCGPlayer Market Price names), keep only mid-era sets (DP→SM inclusive), rank by that snapshot's market price, freeze the top 50 product IDs. Chase style is holo / EX / GX / FA / SA / Prime / LV.X / Legend / Secret / Rainbow / Shiny Vault. Daily job does not rebuild this list.
